title: Remove Properties
description: Removes message exchange properties whose name matches a specified pattern

id.title: Id
id.description: Sets the id of this node

note.title: Note
note.description: Sets the note of this node

description.title: Description
description.description: Sets the description of this node

disabled.title: Disabled
disabled.description: Disables this EIP from the route.

pattern.title: Pattern
pattern.description: Name or pattern of properties to remove. The pattern is matched in the following order: 1 = exact match 2 = wildcard (pattern ends with a and the name starts with the pattern) 3 = regular expression (all of above is case in-sensitive).

excludePattern.title: Exclude Pattern
excludePattern.description: Name or pattern of properties to not remove. The pattern is matched in the following order: 1 = exact match 2 = wildcard (pattern ends with a and the name starts with the pattern) 3 = regular expression (all of above is case in-sensitive).
